next.reason: §2023:7.2.3.4 GR6: the library text is copied 'logically replacing the entire COPY statement beginning with the reserved word COPY and ending with the separator period, inclusive'; §2023:7.2.3.4 GR1 'Text-name-1 or literal-1 identifies the library text'. The replacement effect holds for every COPY statement; literal-1 is a naming alternative recorded with the COPY format, it alters no part of this requirement.
